headline: An explicit symplectic identification of the Leech 3a quotient with the standard six-qutrit F3^12 phase space maps the E8^3 three-W33 root shadow onto 56 points of the 32760-point Leech 90-tight set, split 16+20+20 across the three W33 blocks.

exact_incidence_identities.for_any_three_W33_block_decomposition: if x1 is the Leech-tight-set support-1 count, then support-2 = 7*x1 + 1080 and support-3 = 31680 - 8*x1
exact_incidence_identities.for_any_nondegenerate_4_space_U: if t=|T intersect PG(U)|, then |T intersect PG(U^perp)|=9*t+360

search_boundary: 56 is a certified constructive lower bound from deterministic symplectic-transvection search. No global-maximality claim is made by this certificate.
